items.name: ai-exam-mark
items.description: AI Exam Mark System  A homework marking system built with Next.js and Go, supporting handwritten text recognition and automatic scoring.  ## Features  - Upload homework images - Automatic handwritten text recognition - Support for single-column and double-column exam layouts - Real-time preview and feedback - Responsive design

items.name: AI-Script-Marking-System
items.description: Vision-based AI exam marker grading handwritten scripts against marking schemes with explainable scores.

items.name: online_examination_system
items.description: An automated scoring engine evaluates single-choice, multi-select, and True/False questions with custom positive and negative marking rules. Students receive instant scorecards, grade percentages, and downloadable OpenPDF result reports, while admins access live class metrics and performance analytics.

items.name: Enterprise-internal-practice-examination-system
items.description: Enterprise internal practice and exam system for staff training. It supports question bank management, paper generation, role permission control, auto‑grading and manual marking, with practice and exam modes, anti‑cheating and score statistics.

items.name: Online-Examination-System
items.description: The Online Examination System enables teachers to create subjects, add questions, set time limits, and apply negative marking. Students can take exams digitally, receive instant results, and view scores. The system simplifies test creation, management, and evaluation with an easy, efficient interface.

items.name: AI_POWERED_EXAM_GRADING_SYSTEM_USING_MULTI_MODELS
items.description: An AI-powered automated exam evaluation system that uses Qwen2.5-VL for handwritten answer recognition and Llama 3 for marking-scheme generation, answer evaluation, confidence validation, and automated score calculation.

items.name: Advanced-Online-Examination-System
items.description: Advanced Online Exam System is a web-based application developed using Python, Streamlit, Pandas, Matplotlib, and CSV. It allows students to take multiple-choice exams, calculates scores with negative marking, prevents repeated attempts, and displays results through charts. Admins can add or delete questions, manage settings, and view results.

items.name: Online-Examination
items.description: Developed a Console-Based Online Examination System using Java featuring secure login authentication, interactive MCQ-based exams, automated score calculation with negative marking, result analysis, dashboard navigation, and permanent score history storage using file handling. It simulates a real online test environment in a console interface.

items.name: Student-Management-Sys
items.description: This repository contains the implementation of a Student Management Portal Software. The system allows administrators and teachers to manage student information, including registration, updating, and deletion of student records. It also supports marking and viewing attendance, as well as adding, updating, and viewing exam scores
